'''Khristine Hvam''' is an American voice actress for the English dub of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is currently affiliated with Stewart Talent Agency.

==Pokémon roles==
Khristine Hvam joined the cast during the [[M10|tenth movie]]. She gained a more important role in {{aniseries|BW}} providing the voice of [[Professor Juniper]].
